terms.fr: Prépositions de direction et de mouvement

en.title: Prepositions of direction and movement
en.summary: Prepositions of direction tell where something moves.

paragraphs: Prepositions of direction show the path or goal of a movement. They answer the question Where to? or Which way?. Many of them also work as prepositions of place, with a different meaning.

blocks.html:
PrepositionMovementExample
totowards a goalWe went to Paris.
intofrom outside to insideShe came into the room.
out offrom inside to outsideHe got out of the car.
ontoto a surfaceThe cat jumped onto the table.
fromthe starting pointa train from London
acrossfrom one side to the otheracross the road
throughinside, from one end to the otherthrough the park
alongfollowing a linealong the river
up / downhigher or lowerup the stairs, down the hill
pastbeyond, without stoppingpast the church
towardsin the direction oftowards the sea

paragraphs: Use to with verbs of movement: go to school; and at with the place where you are: be at school. Home needs no preposition after go, come, arrive and get: go home, get home. Arrive at a small place or building, arrive in a city or country.

blocks.html:
Movement (to)Position (at / in)
go to the cinemabe at the cinema
go homebe at home
arrive in Londonarrive at the airport

items: **Go straight on** until the traffic lights.
**Go past** the church and **take the second street** on the left.
**Cross** the bridge and **walk along** the river.
Wrong: **I go in the school.** Right: **I go to school.**
Wrong: **He arrived to London.** Right: **in London**
Wrong: **She went to home.** Right: **She went home.**

ro.title: Prepoziții de direcție și mișcare
ro.summary: Prepozițiile de mișcare arată direcția unei deplasări și cer aproape întotdeauna cazul acuzativ.

paragraphs: Prepozițiile de direcție arată ținta sau drumul unei mișcări. Ele răspund la întrebarea „încotro?”. Cele mai multe prepoziții de mișcare cer cazul acuzativ.
Pui prepoziția direct înaintea substantivului. Substantivul stă în acuzativ, de obicei fără articol după prepoziții simple. Pentru locuința proprie, folosești cuvântul „acasă” fără prepoziție.

blocks.html:
PrepozițieSens de mișcareExemplu
laspre o destinațieMerg **la** școală.
înintrare într-un spațiuIntrăm **în** casă.
spreorientare generalăPlecăm **spre** parc.
printraversarea unui locMergem **prin** pădure.
până lalimita deplasăriiAlerg **până la** magazin.
